facts.text: The University of La Verne was founded as Lordsburg College in 1891 by members of the Church of the Brethren.

sources.title: General Information < University of La Verne
sources.quote: The University of La Verne was founded as Lordsburg College in 1891 by members of the Church of the Brethren, a denomination with roots in 18th century Germany, who later immigrated to Pennsylvania seeking religious freedom.

facts.text: All undergraduate students at the University of La Verne are required to complete a major/concentration senior seminar or major-designated culminating course in residence.

sources.title: Undergraduate Graduation Requirements < University of La Verne
sources.quote: All undergraduate students of the University of La Verne must register for and complete their major/concentration senior seminar or major-designated culminating course in residence at the University of La Verne.
